name: Dragonmaw clan
summary: Across Khaz Modan, Dragonmaw remnants still lurk in wetlands and mountains. During the Second War, they became infamous for subduing and riding red dragons. After Alexstrasza was freed, the scattered orcs remained hostile to both the Alliance and Thrall's New Horde.

sections.title: From Draenor to Azeroth
sections.body: The Dragonmaw crossed the Dark Portal from Draenor with the Old Horde. On Azeroth, they turned their skill toward subduing its winged terrors.

sections.title: The Demon Soul and Grim Batol
sections.body:
Black dragon Deathwing whispered to Zuluhed the Whacked, chieftain of the Dragonmaw, and led him to an ancient golden disk called the Dragon Soul. Zuluhed gave it to Nekros Skullcrusher, his greatest warlock. Nekros drew on its fel taint and named it the Demon Soul. With its agonizing power, he ensnared Alexstrasza the Life-Binder.

The Dragonmaw fortified Grim Batol, an abandoned dwarven bastion, and chained the Dragonqueen in darkness. During the Second War, they forced her red dragon brood to serve the Old Horde as aerial dreadnoughts.

sections.title: The Fall of the Dragon Riders
sections.body:
The Dragonmaw reign ended when the Demon Soul was destroyed, freeing Alexstrasza and her flight from psychic torment. Alexstrasza devoured Nekros Skullcrusher, and her vengeful flight laid waste to Grim Batol. The clan's strength broke.

Routed and terrified, survivors scattered into the Wetlands' marshy bogs and the jagged peaks around Grim Batol. The Dragonmaw who remain on Azeroth are desperate, feral renegades. They fiercely guard their dwindling camps against dwarven patrols and vengeful dragons, and remain hostile to both the Alliance and Thrall's New Horde.

faq.q: Why are they called the Dragonmaw if they are from Draenor?
faq.answer: The clan became infamous on Azeroth for enslaving and riding red dragons for the Old Horde during the Second War.

faq.q: How did the clan manage to control giant red dragons?
faq.answer: The Demon Soul gave Nekros Skullcrusher power over the dragons. The black Aspect Deathwing had passed the ancient artifact to the clan, and Nekros used it to inflict torturous agony on Alexstrasza. He forced her and her flight to obey under threat of her destruction.

faq.q: Are the Dragonmaw part of Thrall's Horde?
faq.answer: No. The Dragonmaw served the Old Horde of Blackhand and his sons. Thrall's New Horde rejected demon worship and the enslavement of dragons, leaving the Dragonmaw as renegade outcasts hostile to both Horde and Alliance.

faq.q: What happened to the clan after the Second War?
faq.answer: When the Demon Soul was destroyed, the freed red dragons turned on the Dragonmaw and destroyed Grim Batol. Nekros was slain, and survivors fled into the Wetlands and neighboring mountains. They remain entrenched there as aggressive raiders.
Zuluhed the Whacked was the Dragonmaw clan's elder shaman and chieftain. Deathwing first gave him visions of dragon riding.

faq.q: Where can Dragonmaw orcs be found right now?
faq.answer: Dragonmaw orcs are found on Azeroth mainly in the Wetlands, around Angerfang Encampment and the grim approaches to Grim Batol. They constantly skirmish with the dwarves of Menethil Harbor and the Wildhammer clan.

angles.text: The Alliance remembers the terrifying rain of fire the Dragonmaw brought upon its fleets and armies during the Second War. Any sighting in Khaz Modan brings an immediate military response.
To dwarves, the Dragonmaw are a desecration. They fouled the ancient fortress of Grim Batol and still infest Khaz Modan's mountain passes.
To the orcs of Thrall's New Horde, the Dragonmaw embody the cruelty and fel corruption of the Old Horde that brought ruin upon their people.
Warlocks study Nekros Skullcrusher's history. His mastery of the Demon Soul showed how fel energies could subjugate even Azeroth's grandest creatures.
